subject: houndeye
leg: control: Valve's own against the brief
label: houndeye, in the place of the game's models/houndeye.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/headcrab.mdl, models/chumtoad.mdl, models/roach.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked B, D, A, D where the asset was C, A, B, B: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Against the brief's words: a squat, rounded yellow body on legs, one large round front opening, a spined dorsal ridge. In the side and angle views the outline holds together with no part sticking out or missing. The body is nearly as tall as it is long (44.7 against 49.3), which is the brief's own size and reads as squat enough.

M2.reason: Measured size is 49.3 long and 44.7 tall against the brief's 49 and 45, both well within 15%. Width is 33.5 and the brief gives none.

M3.reason: Named parts: three legs, one large eye on the front, the body, and the striped, dappled hide. Three legs show in the front view and two or three in the side and back-left views. The one large round front opening is present, though a viewer could read it as a maw rather than an eye. Stripes and mottling are painted on the surface and read clearly at game size.

M4.reason: Body is yellow-green as the brief says, with cyan and brown-orange stripes, a pale belly and a leathery skin-like finish. The front opening's dark dotted interior and the pinkish rim read as one material. Nothing is off in colour against the brief's words.

M5.reason: The striped hide is there (cyan and brown-orange bands over the back and top) and the yellow body is mottled and dappled, as the brief asks. The detail is sharp enough at the size the game shows it.

M6.reason: Capped here by the line-up test. In the line-up the asset (letter C in that order) was never picked as the one not made by Valve across four readings (picked B, D, A, D), so it passed for one of the game's.

M7.reason: The front is the large round opening, and it faces the same way in every side and motion frame. The creature stands upright on three legs with its body off the floor, as Valve's stand.

M8.reason: SMAK check reports no errors. 308 triangles, well under twice the median (576 gives 1152) and under the third quartile. From the views nothing visible is open or inside out; the front opening reads as a recess and the belly's red-and-white marking is painted. The underside is seen only from below.

C1.reason: In the run frames (0, 3, 5, 8, 10, 13, 15, 18 of 18) and the attack frames (0 to 59), the legs stay joined to the body and move with it. The front opening widens through the attack, and nothing comes apart, sinks or floats in the frames shown.
